daily.today_energy: Your mind is buzzing with possibilities today, Gemini. That restless energy you're feeling? It's actually creative fuel. Channel it into something that excites you instead of letting it scatter.

daily.career: Your ideas are hitting different today. Trust that gut feeling about a project or direction. This isn't the time to play it safe—your unique perspective is exactly what's needed. Speak up.
